guidance_get.name: guidance_get
guidance_get.title: Guidance Get
guidance_get.description: Read bundled Odoo guidance before using Odoo tools. Defaults to the skills index; select a listed path for detailed guidance. Also available via skill://odoo/{path} resources. Guidance does not grant write approval or override client policy.

action_list_actions.name: action_list_actions
action_list_actions.title: Action List Actions
action_list_actions.description: List available Odoo actions from ir.actions.server and ir.actions.act_window. Each result is tagged with action_type='server' or action_type='window'. domain: optional Odoo domain filter applied to each model independently. limit: max results per action model (default 80). Returns combined list.

action_execute_action.name: action_execute_action
action_execute_action.title: Action Execute Action
action_execute_action.description: Execute an ir.actions.server action by its id. Calls the 'run' method on ir.actions.server with the given action_id. Returns the action result dict (or empty dict if the action returns None). action_id: numeric id of the ir.actions.server record to execute.

attachments_list.name: attachments_list
attachments_list.title: Attachments List
attachments_list.description: List ir.attachment records. Optionally filter by res_model and/or res_id to get attachments for a specific record. domain: additional Odoo domain filter (merged with model/id filters). res_model: Odoo model name to filter by. res_id: numeric record id to filter by. limit: max results (default 80).

attachments_upload.name: attachments_upload
attachments_upload.title: Attachments Upload
attachments_upload.description: Upload a file as an ir.attachment linked to an Odoo record. name: filename for the attachment. content_base64: base64-encoded file content. res_model: Odoo model name of the linked record. res_id: numeric id of the linked record. mimetype: MIME type (default 'application/octet-stream'). Returns the new attachment id.

attachments_download.name: attachments_download
attachments_download.title: Attachments Download
attachments_download.description: Download an ir.attachment by id through a private signed URL. Returns filename, MIME type, byte size, SHA-256 and expiry/cleanup metadata; never returns binary content or base64. Requires configured artifact storage. Odoo is only read; delivery creates a temporary stored copy. If the attachment has no binary content (empty datas field), returns an error dict. attachment_id: numeric id of the ir.attachment record.

discovery_list_models.name: discovery_list_models
discovery_list_models.title: Discovery List Models
discovery_list_models.description: List up to 500 accessible Odoo models (technical name, label, description). Use discovery_get_fields to inspect a model's fields before operating on it.

discovery_get_fields.name: discovery_get_fields
discovery_get_fields.title: Discovery Get Fields
discovery_get_fields.description: Return field metadata for an Odoo model. Includes type, label, required, readonly, help text, and relational target model. Pass record_id for friendly property names and allowed choices, or property_field + parent_id before a child record exists. Properties are scoped to their definition parent.

discovery_list_menus.name: discovery_list_menus
discovery_list_menus.title: Discovery List Menus
discovery_list_menus.description: List Odoo application menus (ir.ui.menu). Returns menu entries ordered by sequence. Use domain to filter by parent or action type.

mail_post_message.name: mail_post_message
mail_post_message.title: Mail Post Message
mail_post_message.description: Post a message to any Odoo record's chatter (mail.thread mixin). Calls message_post on the given model/res_id. model: Odoo model name (e.g. 'res.partner'). res_id: numeric record id. body: message content. body_format: md (default), html or txt. Markdown becomes basic Odoo HTML; txt preserves literal text; Odoo sanitizes HTML. is_internal: True selects the internal-note subtype, intended for internal audiences. partner_ids: res.partner IDs to notify, not res.users IDs; resolve users' partner_id. Explicit recipients do not exclude followers or other Odoo notification behavior. Posting does not guarantee email delivery or a particular visibility policy. attachment_ids: list of existing ir.attachment ids to link. Returns message_id. A lost write reply needs readback before retry. Denial stops the call.

mail_log_note.name: mail_log_note
mail_log_note.title: Mail Log Note
mail_log_note.description: Post an internal note on any Odoo record's chatter. Calls message_post with is_internal=True and subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note'. model: Odoo model name. res_id: numeric record id. body: note content. body_format: md (default), html or txt. Markdown becomes basic Odoo HTML; txt preserves literal text; Odoo sanitizes HTML. No recipient-list input; use mail_post_message(is_internal=True) for explicit partners. Intended for internal audiences; Odoo controls visibility and notifications. Does not guarantee zero emails. Returns message_id. A lost write reply needs readback before retry; denial stops the call.

mail_list_messages.name: mail_list_messages
mail_list_messages.title: Mail List Messages
mail_list_messages.description: List chatter messages for an Odoo record. Calls search_read on mail.message with domain filtered by model and res_id. Returns messages ordered by date descending. model: Odoo model name. res_id: numeric record id. limit: max messages to return (default 80). offset: pagination offset.

mail_schedule_activity.name: mail_schedule_activity
mail_schedule_activity.title: Mail Schedule Activity
mail_schedule_activity.description: Schedule an activity on any Odoo record. Calls activity_schedule on the mail.activity.mixin. model: Odoo model name. res_id: numeric record id. activity_type_id: numeric id from this instance's mail.activity.type records. date_deadline: due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. note: optional activity note. user_id: optional assignee user id.

mail_list_activities.name: mail_list_activities
mail_list_activities.title: Mail List Activities
mail_list_activities.description: List pending activities for an Odoo record. Calls search_read on mail.activity filtered by model and res_id. model: Odoo model name. res_id: numeric record id. limit: max activities to return (default 80).

mail_mark_activity_done.name: mail_mark_activity_done
mail_mark_activity_done.title: Mail Mark Activity Done
mail_mark_activity_done.description: Mark an activity as done with optional feedback. Calls action_feedback on mail.activity. activity_id: numeric id of the activity to complete. feedback: optional feedback text posted to the chatter.

model_call.name: model_call
model_call.title: Model Call
model_call.description: Call a method on any installed Odoo model using the caller's credentials. model and method are technical names; args is the native positional argument array and kwargs is the keyword argument object. Omitted/null args and kwargs default to [] and {}. Pass Odoo context inside kwargs.context as an object. Recordset methods commonly take an ID list as the first positional argument, e.g. args=[[42]]. Returns result containing the unchanged native JSON value; returned actions are not executed. Methods can read, change or delete data and cause external effects: know the method contract and obtain authority for its effects. This tool adds no confirmation mechanism or privilege elevation. The client's existing safety guard is retained; no safetyLevel override. Do not retry automatically after an unknown outcome; inspect actual state first.

record_search.name: record_search
record_search.title: Record Search
record_search.description: Search records of any Odoo model using a domain filter. Returns matching records with the requested fields in a single call. domain uses raw Odoo domain syntax: list of triples, e.g. [['active','=',True]]. Pagination: pass limit + offset. Default limit=80. Use a bounded positive integer limit. max_return_bytes defaults to 500 UTF-8 JSON bytes: larger results return only a private JSON artifact receipt with a signed URL (default 60 minutes). Set 0 to force artifact delivery, null to return the full result inline. Odoo is only read; artifact delivery creates a temporary stored copy. Select friendly properties with fields such as properties.task_properties.priority. The same path and friendly choices work in domain predicates constrained to one definition parent. Property filtering happens before pagination.

record_read.name: record_read
record_read.title: Record Read
record_read.description: Read fields of specific records by id list. max_return_bytes defaults to 500 UTF-8 JSON bytes: larger results return only a private JSON artifact receipt with a signed URL (default 60 minutes). Set 0 to force artifact delivery, null to return the full result inline. Odoo is only read; artifact delivery creates a temporary stored copy. Select properties.<container> or properties.<container>.<name> for friendly names and choice values discovered through discovery_get_fields.

record_create.name: record_create
record_create.title: Record Create
record_create.description: Create one record from ordinary values and optional properties, using {container: {friendly_name: value}} and discovered friendly choices. Supply each container's positive definition-parent ID in values. Omitted properties retain Odoo defaults; null clears. Do not mix raw containers with friendly properties. All properties are preflighted before one create. Returns id and web_url. Never retry an unknown write automatically.

record_update.name: record_update
record_update.title: Record Update
record_update.description: Update ordinary fields through values. For one record, properties accepts {container: {friendly_name: value}} sparse changes using discovered names and choices. Omitted properties remain unchanged; null clears. Lists replace that property's selected values. Mixed values/properties use one write. Read/merge/write is non-atomic against concurrent edits. Never retry an unknown write automatically.

users_whoami.name: users_whoami
users_whoami.title: Users Whoami
users_whoami.description: Return the authenticated Odoo user identity and configured target URL. username is the Odoo login value from the X-Odoo-Username header. URL and database are connection context, not a test/production classification.

users_search_users.name: users_search_users
users_search_users.title: Users Search Users
users_search_users.description: Search Odoo users by domain filter. Returns res.users records. Default fields: id, name, login, active, share.
